currentManifestInventory.summary: Current academy manifests are mostly flat files under manifests/. The flat layout is workable for validators, but it is no longer readable as a long-term asset registry now that H5 includes shared assets, hub assets, game sheets, topdown sublanes, visual-pantry indexes, cleanup candidates, animation manifests, and source-intake records.

currentDocsInventory.summary: docs/assets/ has become a flat scroll of H4/H5 reports plus doctrine, workflow, tutorial, evidence, pantry, and pipeline documents. The files are useful, but the folder no longer communicates what is doctrine, what is a lane report, what is a game-specific report, what is pantry state, or what is historical evidence.

migrationPhases.label: Visual Tool Suite Registry Plan
migrationPhases.goal: Define how Flipbook, Sticker/Picture Book, Particle FX Viewer, and future audio tooling should discover assets from the pantry and organized manifests without runtime wiring.

migrationPhases.label: Font Pantry Intake Plan or Font Intake
migrationPhases.goal: If fonts are needed before runtime polish, inventory and route font assets as a separate visual-adjacent pantry lane.

migrationPhases.label: Manifest Folder Reorganization Dry Run
migrationPhases.goal: Generate an exact move map, update validators for recursive discovery, and validate both old and proposed paths before moving any manifest.

migrationPhases.label: Asset Docs Reorganization Dry Run
migrationPhases.goal: Generate an exact docs/assets move map and link/reference update list before moving any report.

migrationPhases.label: Stale Overview Docs Correction
migrationPhases.goal: Update current overview docs such as README and progress trackers while preserving historical reports as historical evidence.

migrationPhases.label: Button Goblin Clicker Runtime Visual Integration Plan
migrationPhases.goal: Plan the first runtime visual integration using the accepted pantry and background anchors, without starting Top-Down Slime Quest runtime first.

migrationPhases.label: Button Goblin Clicker Background Runtime Wiring
migrationPhases.goal: Wire the accepted Button Goblin Clicker background into runtime only after H6.0 planning and review.
